datasets.purpose: Model 1 interview transcript and vocal-delivery feature source; Big Five and direct speaking_skills targets.
datasets.source: AI4A-lab RecruitView dataset on Hugging Face
datasets.citation: Gupta, A. K., Sheth, F., Shaikh, H., Kumar, D., Puniya, A., Panwar, D., Chaurasia, S., & Mathur, P. (2025). RecruitView: A Multimodal Dataset for Predicting Personality and Interview Performance for Human Resources Applications. arXiv:2512.00450.
datasets.licence: CC BY-NC 4.0 (dataset card; verify institutional use terms before redistribution).
datasets.notes: Raw metadata contains 2,011 interview rows. The active study retains the five Big Five labels and speaking_skills only; video is decoded into aggregate numerical audio columns and is never passed directly to the predictor.

datasets.purpose: Model 2 dataset: BFI-2 domain-scale inputs and BESSI domain-scale soft-skill targets.
datasets.source: Authors' OSF project 4zgyr, College student sample.xlsx; upstream version 1 checksum exactly matches the local workbook.
datasets.citation: Soto, C. J., Napolitano, C. M., Sewell, M. N., Yoon, H. J., & Roberts, B. W. (2022). An integrative framework for conceptualizing and assessing social, emotional, and behavioral skills: The BESSI. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 123(1), 192-222. https://doi.org/10.1037/pspp0000401
datasets.licence: No explicit dataset licence in OSF project or parent metadata (node_license null). Public availability and article licensing do not establish workbook redistribution rights. Do not redistribute the workbook without checking terms.
datasets.notes: The workbook has 322 measurement rows. Its Case column is reused across rows with distinct values, so it must not be treated as a unique participant identifier. Source verification applies to College student sample.xlsx; the separate scoring-template file was not hash-verified. Original download date remains unknown.
